summary_en: 0xvimer proposed ERC-8118, a standard interface for authorizing autonomous agents to perform specific onchain actions for users. A Truebit contract deployed in 2021 was exploited for about $26M. TimBeiko said he will shift from L1 R&D to frontier Ethereum use cases. nero_eth and soispoke debated whether FOCIL equals censorship resistance.
